purpose: Reconstruct or replace the HPACK interoperability evidence without trusting availability of the original download host.

source.closest_original_note: The h2 import matches this original corpus revision except for a one-byte correction in go-hpack/story_06.json; the per-file hashes below are authoritative.

reconstruction.exact: Retrieve any copy of the h2 v0.4.20 fixture subtree and require every per-file digest plus the canonical tree digest to match.
reconstruction.raw_story_substitute: Create ordered request/response header stories with the recorded case counts and contexts. Preserve each story's compression context across its cases and record a new semantic_headers_sha256.
reconstruction.encoded_story_substitute: For every raw story, generate RFC 7541 blocks with several independent encoders spanning literal/static/dynamic indexing, Huffman on/off, and table-size changes. Decoder acceptance is valid only when every block yields the source story's ordered headers.
reconstruction.minimum_diversity: Retain at least one family for each table/Huffman combination represented below plus an independent implementation exercising dynamic-table size updates.
reconstruction.nonessential_files: README.md and the ratio utilities document provenance and analysis; .travis.yml is historical. They may be replaced by equivalent documentation/tooling without weakening decoder interoperability coverage.

raw-data.strategy: Unencoded request/response header sequences shared by every encoder family.
